definition: Stephen Robertson is a British computer scientist.
details: He is known for his work on probabilistic information retrieval together with Karen Spärck Jones and the Okapi BM25 weighting model.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Stephen Robertson (computer scientist).
